notes: Brazilian Portuguese conventions (Salvar, Excluir, Compartilhar, Baixar, Enviar for upload, arquivo, tela), kept as neutral as practical. Address the user as "você" but avoid the pronoun where possible; instructions use the você imperative (Tente novamente, Escolha, Clique). Sentence case for labels, buttons and headings (only proper nouns capitalised: Bíblia, Antigo/Novo Testamento). Curly double quotes “…” for quoted UI/option names. Error toasts follow the English shape "Não foi possível … — tente novamente". Keep the em dash and ellipsis as in the English. "design" is a masculine loanword (o design, os designs), as in Canva's Portuguese UI. Sign in = Entrar (the process: login; a sign-in link: link de acesso). Printing terms: interior = miolo, double-sided = frente e verso, long/short edge = borda longa/curta, copy (printed book) = exemplar. Option names on Lulu's English-only site stay in English.
